name: dsh-warm
description: DeepSeek Harness host plugin: prompt-cache warmer. While a session's agent loop is blocked inside a tool execution (bash, wait_agent, job_output, ...), re-dispatches the session's last conversation request through the llm waterfall with max_tokens=1 every interval so the provider's prompt-cache prefix stays warm; never warms idle sessions or user-input tools. Journal + budget at $DSH_HOME/storages/dsh-warm/.
